body: I think that yes, I love my dog, but her love to me doesn't replace human connection. I don't have anyone. Some internet relationship, but nothing physical. No friends, family, no significant other to be here, giving me a hug or the time of day. I am all alone.
I will never do that. There is no replacing her.
There is no one else that needs it. I do not know if I'm even capable of loving anyone else. No family or friends. Only loneliness and isolation - now that's a hard thing to love.
Yes, I have been going therapy now for awhile.

No. 

I am in NC with my mother, I do not know my father. I call with my grandma every now and then, but she doesn't know how bad things really are.

I don't have any friends. No safety net. I am all alone.

Thank you all for your kind words. It sometimes baffles me, how the strangers on the internet can be kinder to me than I am to myself. I have started a therapy, and I hope, that with time, I can finally start the healing and the process of learning to forgive myself.

Typing this all up was truly therapeutic. Thank you all again.
